schema.source_policy: First-party official operator, merchant, e-money, transit and regulator pages only; planning URLs are not evidence until fetched.
schema.quote_policy: No verbatim quotation fields are used; evidence_locator points to fetched official page sections.

bounded_run.scope: Live first-party pages reachable from P0 planning leads and official linked pages, bounded to visible/reachable content during this run.
bounded_run.truncation: Dynamic directories were recorded only as rendered/reachable; unrendered children and blocked pages were not inferred.
bounded_run.fetch_policy: Admitted claims map to official fetched pages; METI official locator is preserved as HTTP 403 failure.

metadata.publisher_policy: Official first-party operator/merchant/regulator domains only; search snippets and third-party authority were not evidence.
metadata.pii_or_secret_check: No credentials, account data, payment data, tokens or personal identifiers included.

claims.subject: nanaco summer festival
claims.short_paraphrase: The page displays a 10,000-winner lottery for 775 points without visible dates.

claims.subject: nanaco
claims.short_paraphrase: Nanaco supports cash/card/autocharge/app and prior registration with 24-hour wait.

claims.subject: nanaco
claims.short_paraphrase: Nanaco shows 1 point per ¥200 before tax and later-store monthly posting.

claims.subject: Seven Card Plus/Gold
claims.short_paraphrase: Seven Card Plus/Gold earn 1 point per ¥200 on credit charge.

claims.subject: nanaco points
claims.short_paraphrase: One point exchanges to ¥1 with no fee and cannot be canceled.

claims.subject: WAON August campaign
claims.short_paraphrase: The directory lists a 10,000-point lottery for charging August 14–31.

claims.subject: WAON POINT integration
claims.short_paraphrase: From March 1, stores transition to WAON POINT with two-year maximum expiry.

claims.subject: WAON autocharge
claims.short_paraphrase: Autocharge earns 1 per ¥200 or 2 at registered target stores.

claims.subject: WAON
claims.short_paraphrase: WAON earns 1 point per ¥200 including tax.

claims.subject: WAON credit charge
claims.short_paraphrase: The official list includes the named WAON/AEON/JAL/Apple Pay classes.

claims.subject: WAON card
claims.short_paraphrase: WAON card costs ¥350, has no annual fee and has ¥50,000/¥49,000 limits.

claims.subject: 7NOW Pocka Sapporo
claims.short_paraphrase: Each period requires at least ¥1,000 before tax and one use per 7iD.

claims.subject: 7NOW
claims.short_paraphrase: 7NOW excludes the listed postal, prepaid, publication and flammable-goods classes.

claims.subject: Seven-Eleven ANA card
claims.short_paraphrase: The ANA benefit was 1 mile per ¥200 including tax and ended 2026-05-31.

claims.subject: Seven-Eleven Saison/UC card
claims.short_paraphrase: The Saison/UC benefit was 1 point per ¥100 including tax and ended 2026-08-10.

claims.subject: 7NOW
claims.short_paraphrase: 7NOW shows the stated hours, fee range, minimum and payment methods.

claims.subject: AEON points
claims.short_paraphrase: The page lists product, point-paid, non-AEON QR and non-target-store exclusions.

claims.subject: AEON target group stores
claims.short_paraphrase: Target tenders earn 2 per ¥200 including tax; basic is 1 and grant day is 25.

claims.subject: Amazon Pay
claims.short_paraphrase: Amazon Pay lists cards, Amazon Gift Card, Paidy, JCB J-POINT and merpay.

claims.subject: Amazon Pay first use
claims.short_paraphrase: The directory displays a first-use offer up to 20%; child dates were not rendered.

claims.subject: Amazon Pay
claims.short_paraphrase: J-Debit is unavailable and some methods depend on merchants.

claims.subject: Bic Camera.com
claims.short_paraphrase: The official online list includes cards, bank/convenience/netbank/ATM, wallets, Paidy and gift cards.

claims.subject: Bic Point
claims.short_paraphrase: Bic displays 10%, 1 point=¥1 and two-year-after-last-use expiry.

claims.subject: FamilyMart
claims.short_paraphrase: FamilyMart lists FamiPay, points, cards, wallets and e-money.

claims.subject: FamiPay August games
claims.short_paraphrase: August games show a ¥100,000 daily maximum and 90%/¥1,500 payment game.

claims.subject: FamiPay
claims.short_paraphrase: FamiPay excludes listed agency collections, multicopy services and e-money charging.

claims.subject: FamiPay
claims.short_paraphrase: FamiPay requires the app and cannot combine with other e-money or credit card.

claims.subject: Ito-Yokado specialty nanaco
claims.short_paraphrase: Eligible nanaco earns 4 per ¥200 including tax on listed dates.

claims.subject: Ito-Yokado nanaco charge
claims.short_paraphrase: At the two named stores, Thursday ¥10,000 charging earns 100 points once daily.

claims.subject: Lawson
claims.short_paraphrase: Lawson lists the methods and au PAY ¥300,000 cap.

claims.subject: Lawson sale directory
claims.short_paraphrase: The current directory shows August 18–31 and August 18–September 7 campaigns.

claims.subject: Lawson Ponta/d point
claims.short_paraphrase: Lawson shows time-band rates, Ponta Plus maxima and 1 point=¥1 with 20,000 cap.

claims.subject: d-point transfer
claims.short_paraphrase: The August campaign advertises +50% with maximum 15% bonus.

claims.subject: Matsukiyo stage
claims.short_paraphrase: Matsukiyo shows monthly/annual 2x/3x thresholds and ¥150,000 cap.

claims.subject: McDonald's Japan
claims.short_paraphrase: McDonald's lists barcode, e-money, mobile wallets, cards, JCB PreMo and McCard.

claims.subject: Rewards raffle
claims.short_paraphrase: The 250-point raffle ran in two February–March 2026 periods and is ended.

claims.subject: My McDonald's Rewards
claims.short_paraphrase: Registered mobile-order/McDelivery spend earns 1 point per ¥10 including tax, valid one year.

claims.subject: NewDays self-checkout
claims.short_paraphrase: NewDays self-checkout lists transit e-money, cards and named barcodes.

claims.subject: JRE POINT scratch
claims.short_paraphrase: The campaign gives ¥150/¥100/¥50 rewards, one per person/period, valid two weeks.

claims.subject: JRE POINT at NewDays
claims.short_paraphrase: Registered Suica earns 1 point per ¥200 including tax; 1 point is ¥1.

claims.subject: Rakuten Ichiba
claims.short_paraphrase: Rakuten Ichiba lists the methods and ¥9,999,999 including-tax cap.

claims.subject: Rakuten 18th-day
claims.short_paraphrase: The campaign shows rank multipliers, 1,000 cap, entry and following-month expiry.

claims.subject: Rakuten Ichiba
claims.short_paraphrase: Standard earning is 1 point per ¥100 before tax with the stated grant window.

claims.subject: Starbucks Stars
claims.short_paraphrase: Card issue/load, balance transfer and return-card purchases do not earn Stars.

claims.subject: Starbucks Stars
claims.short_paraphrase: Starbucks gives store/eGift and online formulas, rounding, Gold threshold and reward validity.

claims.subject: Welcia summer bonus
claims.short_paraphrase: The ended campaign required ¥1,500 and capped bonus at ¥1,000 per transaction/¥20,000 per period.

claims.subject: Welcia online points
claims.short_paraphrase: Welcia shows online rates/value and physical-only 20th-day 1.5x use.

claims.subject: Yahoo 爆買ウルトラSALE
claims.short_paraphrase: The future sale shows +4% from ¥5,000, +7% from ¥20,000 and 21% maximum total.

claims.subject: Yahoo PayPay Step
claims.short_paraphrase: The page gives funding rates and 30-payment/¥100,000 qualification for +0.5% next month.

claims.subject: Gold Point Card Plus
claims.short_paraphrase: Gold Point Card Plus adds 3% special points to regular cash rate in named scopes.

claims.subject: Stealth marketing
claims.short_paraphrase: CAA states the effective date and covered media/regulated actor.

claims.subject: CAA legal-measure statistics
claims.short_paraphrase: CAA published a July 31 notice covering through June 30, 2026.

claims.subject: FSA provider directory
claims.short_paraphrase: FSA provides searchable provider files with displayed as-of dates.

claims.subject: Electronic payment instrument/intermediary business
claims.short_paraphrase: FSA states domestic operation requires registration under the named Acts.

claims.subject: PPC guidelines
claims.short_paraphrase: June 2026 is the bounded PPC change notice.

claims.subject: PPC General Rules Guidelines
claims.short_paraphrase: The guideline records a June 2026 partial revision and covered operator definition.

claims.subject: JRE POINT to Suica
claims.short_paraphrase: JRE POINT converts 1:1 with minimum 1 and ¥20,000 balance cap.

claims.subject: Suica campaigns
claims.short_paraphrase: The directory lists the stated 2026 campaign ranges.

claims.subject: Suica autocharge
claims.short_paraphrase: View Card is required; official examples give 1.5% and 5/15 points per ¥1,000.

claims.subject: JRE POINT with Suica
claims.short_paraphrase: Registration is required for described rail/Mobile Suica earning.

claims.subject: Mobile Suica autocharge
claims.short_paraphrase: Mobile Suica autocharge requires linked View Card.

claims.subject: Suica/JRE POINT
